author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Edge AI is the next big thing
#amdbrandambassador

reshared_post.reshared_text:
Emmy Award winning Light Sail VR uses a private, locally operated AI production coordinator developed on AMD Agent Computers powered by AMD Ryzen AI Max processors and AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 graphics.

The solution helps manage timelines, deadlines and stakeholder updates while keeping sensitive client work local. Light Sail VR reports that it can now oversee up to nine projects with effort comparable to managing just one or two before. This gives its team more time to focus on storytelling.

Watch the partnership highlight, then read the full case study: https://bit.ly/4AKhZjC
